title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, do you need my help transporting anything?

title: Talk 1
original: This noisy metal music… Exusiai must be throwing another party. Doctor, should I go nudge her?

title: Talk 2
original: I'm quite good with manual labor. I also know a bit about company management. So, Doctor, is there anywhere I can be of use?

title: Talk 3
original: My parents were the first generation to settle in Lungmen, so I'm actually a Lungmen native… Doctor, if there's anything you'd like to know about the place, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, if you want to know how a real logistics company operates, it'd be best to just ask me directly. Penguin Logistics is more of an exception than the rule, and though I don't mean this in a bad way, they won't make for a good reference at all.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: What do I like to do outside of work? Besides just resting, I'll sometimes go with Croissant on her shopping trips, help her carry stuff, and make sure she doesn't waste too much money… Want to join us, Doctor?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I used to believe that for any company to survive in the long run, standardization and efficiency were critically important. That's why at first, I couldn't fathom how a company like Penguin Logistics could stay afloat.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: After getting to know more about the people at Penguin Logistics and talking to them, I began to understand that the world is much broader than I had thought. There's nothing wrong with structure and rules, but they don't necessarily apply to everyone.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but to unite such a diverse group of people under your banner, that's no simple feat… It'd be great if I could become more like you one day.

title: Idle
original: Doctor… Oh, it's your nap time. Guess I'll tidy up this place for now.

title: Onboard
original: Pleased to meet you, Doctor. My name is Bison. According to the terms of our contract, I'm now also an employee of Rhodes Island. I look forward to working with you.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Thank you very much. I will make sure to learn from this.

title: Promotion 1
original: Thank you very much, Doctor. I believe that as long as I put my best foot forward, my hard work will be rewarded.

title: Promotion 2
original: With Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen a more expansive world than I knew… Doctor, one day, I will also find my place in this world.

title: Added to Squad
original: A mission? Understood.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: On-site command… I have some experience with that.

title: Depart
original: Yes, I've noted the mission location and objectives.

title: Begin Operation
original: Phew… I'll get my job done.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What would you like me to do?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Is it my turn, Doctor?

title: Deployment 1
original: I'll do my best.

title: Deployment 2
original: Got it.

title: In Battle 1
original: I'll hold my ground.

title: In Battle 2
original: Hang in there a bit longer? Understood.

title: In Battle 3
original: Don't worry, my shield still holds firm.

title: 4-star Result
original: Way to go, Doctor! You're the kind of leader any company would want to hire.

title: 3-star Result
original: Wow, Doctor! You really are amazing.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The basic objectives of the mission have been accomplished. This should be good enough, right?

title: Operation Failure
original: Don't feel down, Doctor. We'll have another chance.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: So this is the inside of Rhodes Island… It sure is big.

title: Tap
original: Where should I go?

title: Trust Tap
original: Sora's new album is really good.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It's New Year's, so on behalf of MountainDash Logistics, I'm sending formal greetings to Rhodes Island. May everything go well for Rhodes Island's employees, and may you be safe and sound in the coming year. Also, here's a personal card from me to you, Doctor, to wish you a Happy New Year. To another great year working together.

title: Greeting
original: Good morning, Doctor!

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday. Please try this bowl of long life noodles. All ingredients have been chosen with care. It has wheat from Yan, steak from Ursus, and the broth is Iberian ham. It took me months to put together, and it was still a rush to get everything in on time. I hope you like it.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: My father says the most precious thing to a business is pulling everyone together under the same ideal. At Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen that cohesion for myself. I have to learn from yours and Emperor's examples, in that regard.
